decisions.reason: As a newly launched add-on that fits the secure identity ecosystem and is likely cheap to carry, it still has option value despite only limited website prominence.
An identity-bound wallet matches the firm's core identity-plus-payments strategy, so uncertainty argues for keeping it, though overlap with other payment offerings creates some pruning risk.

The NFC-tag login product is more niche and likely costlier to support than the firm's software-centric platform options, so with several other options available it is the most plausible candidate to cut.
A secure payment and wallet framework shown on its own page is a core enabling component of the firm's super-app ecosystem strategy and worth retaining while adoption unfolds.
This product is closest to the firm's stated strategic direction of secure multi-service app platforms, so management would strongly prefer to keep the option alive.
The application shielding library leverages the firm's longstanding security capabilities and complements its broader platform offering, making continued market presence likely.
